I wrote the solution to `main.wj`. It passes `wj check`, and `wj run --interpret` gives the expected output for Example 1 (`the 3`, `and 1`).

I didn't run Example 2 or any other inputs. I also didn't run `wj build`, as instructed, so I haven't confirmed it compiles under the production toolchain.

The program reads K from the first line, then splits the rest into runs of ASCII letters and digits.
